trials.name: start + x-mirror action remap
trials.hypothesis: The world mirrors the action x coordinate (shown by the untrained trace). Re-index each type's score map so the logit for action column x_a reads the score computed at obs top-left column X-dx-x_a. That gives the conv head the right brick-to-cell link, so it can learn placements that fill target cells before DONE takes over. Refuted if dev success stays near 0 and episodes still end at DONE straight away.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def remap_x(s, dx):
    # s: [B, 1, Y, X] scores at obs top-left anchors; action x_a covers obs cols X-dx-x_a ..
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(remap_x(out(h), dx))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 48
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def remap_x(s, dx):
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class FootHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(proj, hid, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, fc, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.fconv, self.outs):
            q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = p, p
            else:
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1)) + fc(q))
            res.append(remap_x(out(h), dx))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = FootHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "n_minibatches": 8, "ent_coef": 0.02}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def remap_x(s, dx):
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(remap_x(out(h), dx))

            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.02, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ppo_epochs": 3}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def remap_x(s, dx):
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(remap_x(out(h), dx))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.hypothesis: A placement is right when its landing layer z has target cells missing under the whole footprint and seals nothing below. This replaces the 2D head with a per-layer head that copies the features once per layer and adds a learned per-layer embedding. It pools max/min over the footprint for each layer, then combines the layer scores with logsumexp, so the head can learn exact layer-wise checks. Compute rises about 10%. Uses r2c3's recipe. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.02, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
LD = 32
LE = 16
LH = 16


def remap_x(s, dx):
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class LayerHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_ch, width, Z, footprints):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.obs_proj = nn.Conv2d(in_ch, LD, 1)
        self.f_proj = nn.Conv2d(width, LD, 1, bias=False)
        self.zemb = nn.Embedding(self.Z, LD)
        self.l2 = nn.Conv2d(LD, LE, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * LE, LH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(LH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, obs, f):
        a = self.obs_proj(obs) + self.f_proj(f)
        B, d, Y, X = a.shape
        Z = self.Z
        ez = self.zemb.weight.view(1, Z, d, 1, 1)
        h = F.relu(a.unsqueeze(1) + ez).reshape(B * Z, d, Y, X)
        u = F.relu(self.l2(h))
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn = u, u
            else:
                q = F.pad(u, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn], dim=1))))
            s = s.view(B, Z, Y, X)
            s = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1, keepdim=True)
            res.append(remap_x(s, dx))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = LayerHead(spec.in_channels, WIDTH, spec.Z, spec.footprints)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(obs, f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.02, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def remap_x(s, dx):
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(remap_x(out(h), dx))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c3(f))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.label: r4c2
trials.name: r2c3 + 32-step rollouts
trials.hypothesis: Episodes last about 12 steps and gamma is 0.99, so 16-step rollouts often cut an episode off before its +1 exact-build bonus, and the return is then bootstrapped from a noisy critic. Using 64 envs x 32 steps keeps the batch size (2048), the number of updates and the number of samples, while ending fewer episodes early. That gives cleaner credit for ordering mistakes. Refuted if the 2-seed mean is at or below 0.89.
trials.code:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 16, "ent_coef": 0.02, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


def remap_x(s, dx):
    X = s.shape[-1]
    v = torch.flip(s[..., :X - dx + 1], dims=[-1])
    if dx > 1:
        v = F.pad(v, (0, dx - 1))
    return v


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(remap_x(out(h), dx))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: The starting network learns to choose DONE straight away (episode length 1.0 by 50% of training). The untrained trace shows why. The x coordinate of each action is mirrored: a brick of width dx at action column x_a fills obs columns X-dx-x_a onward. For example, a 1x1 brick at col 2 filled col 5, and a 1x2 brick at col 6 filled cols 0-1. Rows, landing and rewards match the description (the target has 12 cells, so a wrong 1x1 brick scores -1/12-0.01). A translation-equivariant conv head scores the cell it sees, but the brick lands at the mirror position. Placements therefore look random to it, random placements earn negative reward, and DONE (reward 0) wins. Main hypothesis: map each brick type's score map from obs coordinates to action coordinates (flip the valid anchors along x). Candidates: A, the flip alone; B, flip plus a recipe with more and smaller updates and more entropy; C, flip plus a footprint-conv head.
analyses.2: The starting network was built for the wrong action layout. The untrained trace shows that action column x fills columns X-dx-x onward, so the world mirrors x. Re-mapping each brick type's score map fixed this. With the default recipe it reached 0.746 (r1c1). Switching to 128 parallel worlds (64 updates instead of 32) and entropy 0.02 raised it to 0.887 (r1c2). That gain is far larger than the ~3-point gap between seeds. The footprint-conv head (r1c3, 0.674) did not beat r1c1. So the recipe is the main lever right now, not the head. In r1c2, training success was still rising at the end (0.86), so the run looks short of samples or updates. In the design-2 trace the failure is an ordering mistake: a cell under an overhang was filled before its support. Next tests: more fresh samples (fewer PPO epochs), more and smaller updates, and longer-horizon credit (higher gamma and lambda) so the exact-build bonus reaches the early ordering choices.
analyses.3: The x-mirror remap is what made learning possible: it took dev success from 0 to about 0.75–0.89. The best runs are r2c3 (gamma 0.99, lambda 0.95; seeds 0.889 and 0.887) and r1c2 (0.873 and 0.900). These are effectively tied, but r2c3 had a tighter seed spread. Two recipes added updates or samples: r2c1 (2 PPO epochs) and r2c2 (64 envs). In each, seed 0 did well (0.875 and 0.912) but seed 1 collapsed to about 0.46. So seed variance is large (up to about 40 points), and stability matters for the final retrain on 4 new seeds. The exact-footprint conv head (r1c3) did not help. Remaining failures happen at very high IoU (about 0.98), which suggests a few wrong landing layers or ordering mistakes rather than weak perception. This round makes one mild sample increase on the stable r2c3 recipe, adds a head that scores each brick per landing layer, and adds a deeper trunk.
analyses.4: The x-mirror remap is what made the task learnable (0 → 0.75). The best results are r2c3 (0.888, seeds 0.889 and 0.887) and r1c2 (0.887). Both use 128 envs and ent_coef 0.02, and r2c3 also uses gamma 0.99 and lambda 0.95. Changes that gave more updates or more samples (2 or 3 epochs, 64 envs) raised the best single seed to 0.91, but often made one seed collapse to about 0.45. So the 2-seed mean is limited by instability, not by capacity. Spending compute on the network (a third conv, a per-layer head, a footprint conv) cut samples and scored lower. Dev IoU is about 0.985, so the remaining errors are a few wrong or out-of-order bricks. In this last round I keep the r2c3 network and try to stabilise training: more but smaller updates with a lower learning rate, longer rollouts so returns are cut off less often, and per-pixel LayerNorm in the trunk.
